name: Mina Patel
summary: Mina Patel - ready-to-play pre-generated investigator (musician, Folly consultant).
notes: Imported from the Rivers of London rulebook, Appendix A: Ready-to-Play Investigators (printed p.343-349). Stat block reproduced for in-game use; backstory paraphrased. Unallocated pre-gen (scope []): a GM can assign it to a player to pick up and play.

sheet.name: Mina Patel
sheet.backstory: A Leicester-raised musician working a day job in Met data entry while chasing a music career; pulled into Folly work after her friend Morgan Omans asked her advice on a music-related case.
sheet.carry: Folly Consultant's Card, Metropolitan Police Service staff photo ID card, notebook, pens, keyboard, mobile phone, and spare batteries.
